Definition: Asahel, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Asahel = "God-made"; 1) nephew of David, son of David's sister Zeruiah, and brother of Joab and Abishai; swift of foot he was killed by Abner when he pursued him in battle and caught him; 2) a Levite in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah who went through the kingdom giving instruction in the law; 3) a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes and dedicated things in the temple; 4) a priest, father of Jonathan, in the time of Ezra
